column1: # The refusal catalogue of the store (P/01.1–P/01.3 N4): the code, the kind, the word, the fields, the norm. The table is the source of these columns; the prose of N4 refers to it.
# The roles of the three: the OpenAPI *Fault — the form of the body; this table — the catalogue; write-checks.tsv — the order and the conditions of the write command.
# chapter — 1.1, 1.2, 1.3; row — the number of the row of the N4 table of the chapter (from 1); a prose row with two outcomes is two rows with one row.

# name — the refusal, snake_case, unique in the file; the check column of write-checks.tsv, read-checks.tsv, rights-checks.tsv and service-checks.tsv selects this name. Several checks may select one refusal; their stable id is independent of name.

# surface — http (a door), start (the daemon start), cli (an administrative command). code — an HTTP code; exit 2 (the configuration refusal of the start); exit !0 — any non-zero code, including 2; - (no answer).
# kind — the wire word kind (OpenAPI *Fault); - at start and cli. fields — the fields of the body besides kind and error, comma-separated, ? — optional.

# headers — the headers of the answer (no conditional header: a prose row with several causes is several rows here; Retry-After only where named); log — what the log line names (start, cli): a name — the value of the cause (of the names, those the cause has, at least one); «…» — the words verbatim; - — none. The cause in words and «what the caller does» are prose (N4).
